description: Fills the official Israeli Tax Authority form 101 (טופס 101, כרטיס עובד) for tax year 2026 and returns the filled official PDF, with every value and box listed, the credit points (נקודות זיכוי) it claims and what the employee still has to sign and attach. Use when someone starting a job, or updating their details, wants form 101 filled (children, spouse, other income, credit-point reasons, tax coordination). Requires name, birth date, gender, marital status, residency and income type; the ID number is checksum-validated. The signature is never drawn. | ממלא את טופס 101 הרשמי לשנת 2026 ומחזיר PDF מוכן לחתימה. Stateless: arguments and results are never stored, logged or shared (nayeret.ai/developers/). Not legal or tax advice.

apply_suggestions.description: Default true: also tick the credit items that clearly follow from the details (1 resident, 7 or 8 children, 4 aliyah, 13, 14, 15, 16) like the website filler suggests. Items that need a judgement (3, 5, 6) are only ticked when asked.

children.description: Part C: every child under 19 in the tax year (born 2008 or later), also children who do not live with you

i_receive_child_allowance.description: Column 2: I receive the National Insurance child allowance for this child

in_my_custody.description: Column 1: the child lives with me / is in my custody

credit_reasons.description: Part H: credit points and reliefs. Item 1 (resident) is ticked from employee.israeli_resident.

academic_degree.description: 15: finished a degree or professional studies (needs form 119)

kind.description: ba = bachelor, ma = master, pro = professional studies

age_16_to_18.description: 13: I or my spouse turned 16 and not yet 18 in the tax year

alimony_for_children.description: 10: children not in my custody whom I support by a court order

alimony_to_ex_spouse.description: 12: I pay alimony to a former spouse (remarried)

children_in_custody.description: 7: credit for my children in my custody (single parent receiving the allowance, married woman, or sole parent)

children_not_in_custody.description: 8: credit for my children (a parent who did not tick 7, e.g. a married father; a sole parent ticks both 7 and 8)

disability_compensation.description: 2b: also receives a monthly allowance under the Disabled Persons law or the hostile-acts victims law (only with 2a)

disabled_children.description: 11: number of children with disabilities (under 19) for whom I get the disabled child allowance

discharged_soldier.description: 14: discharged soldier / national service in the last 3 years

full_service.description: true = full regular service (2 points a year), false = short service (1 point)

no_income_until.description: No Israeli income from the start of the year until (optional)

qualifying_settlement.description: 3: permanent resident of a qualifying locality (needs form 1312a)

reserve_combat_days.description: 16: days of combat reserve duty in 2025 (credit from 30 days)

single_parent_living_separately.description: 6: single-parent family living separately, children in my custody and I receive their child allowance

sole_parent.description: 9: sole parent (the other parent died or is not registered). Also ticks 7 and 8 when apply_suggestions is on

spouse_without_income.description: 5: spouse lives with me and has no income AND (retirement age or spouse disabled/blind)

declaration_date.description: Date next to the signature (default: today in Israel)

first_name.description: First name as on the ID card

gender.description: m = male, f = female (women get an extra half credit point)

id_number.description: Israeli ID number (9 digits with the check digit). Checksum-validated in memory, never stored.

israeli_resident.description: Israeli resident (center of life in Israel). Almost every employee in Israel: true

kibbutz.description: Kibbutz/cooperative moshav member; income from this employer transferred to the kibbutz or not

last_name.description: Last name as on the ID card

marital_status.description: separated only with a tax assessor approval

passport.description: Only if there is no Israeli ID number

employer.description: Part A (optional, the employer usually fills it)

deductions_file.description: Withholding file number (9 digits starting with 9)

credit_points_here.description: With other income: true = give me the credit points and tax brackets HERE (and not at the other income); false = at the other income

has_other_income.description: Part E: true if I have another salary, pension or scholarship now (a job that ended before this one does not count)

no_pension_on_other.description: No pension / disability insurance / severance deposits on the other income (or they are added to it)

no_study_fund_on_other.description: No study-fund deposits on the other income (or they are added to it)

start_date.description: Start date at this employer in the tax year (worked there before 2026? use 2026-01-01)

type.description: What I get from THIS employer: monthly (regular salary, most people), additional (this is a second job), partial (up to 5 hours a day), daily (paid per day, under 18 days a month), pension, scholarship

lang.description: Language of the summary text: he (default) or en. Files stay in Hebrew (official forms and Israeli letters).

has_income.description: Does the spouse have any income

income_from_work.description: Spouse income from work / business / salary

assessor_approval.description: T3: the tax assessor approved a coordination (attach the approval)

no_income_since_year_start.description: T1: no income from the start of the tax year until starting this job

tax_year.description: Tax year of the form. Only 2026 (official revision 11.2025) is available.
